In 5 years' service working in our small community's townhall office as administrative coordinator for the zoning commission and board of education. I learned that even small blunder like mistakingly sending a public hearing schedule to an individual resident rather sending the official email chain list could lead down the rabbit holes.

After sending the schedule to one resident via regular old private message in error - thinking "what could go bad from an honest accident" I quickly learned to be vigilant.

When I went into work the very early next day - there on a stack from a colleague, a formal written grievANCE. I had unwittingedly caused some upset with the unintended message that morning - I should've just followed proper protocol, the formal list for sure and double checked again after sending.

This small error led not directly - but certainly in the direction for a major rethinking
